theme: An open day, with Croatia five days out.
greeting: A quiet calendar today, Dan - one call with Brunswick and the rest of the day your own. The real pull is Croatia, now five days off, with a handful of bookings still hanging.

needsAttention.title: Conor Kehoe call on PRI, 10 AM
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's Zoom is on PRI sustainability and stewardship - a networking conversation, so it goes better if you arrive holding two or three clear thoughts on where stewardship is heading.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings still open
needsAttention.detail: The last night in Cavtat (Sept 19) and the St Pete landing gap (Sept 20-22) are both still unbooked and flagged p1. You fly Sept 8 and charter connectivity is poor - these want locking from dry land this week.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows zero checked bags, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on. Confirming on the operating carrier's site now beats airport-counter rates.

needsAttention.title: Andrew Kaufmann's reconnect note
needsAttention.detail: He wrote via LinkedIn after a bounced KPMG address, asking whether you're still there and open to picking the thread back up. A short reply keeps it warm.

needsAttention.title: Travel larder bin before the changeover
needsAttention.detail: Today is the House 1 to House 2 move, and the bin was meant to be packed before it - the first migration is the test run while there's still time to fix it.

schedule.title: Brunswick: Lauren + Dan
schedule.detail: Intro call with Lauren Nadig, Brunswick Group

flagged.title: NACD New England panel prep
flagged.detail: Larissa Ravetto sent the Oct 8 Zoom prep session for the Oct 28 New England event, with you on the invite alongside the panel.

flagged.title: C&C Sprayfoam estimate, $12,450
flagged.detail: New QuickBooks estimate, due end of year - a review when you have a moment.

flagged.title: ICGN Autumn Conference, Toronto
flagged.detail: Bookings are open for the November governance conference.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and digests - Union Square Wines, Lumosity, Chairish, LinkedIn job alerts.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

resolved.title: PRI call with Conor Kehoe booked
resolved.detail: After a couple of reschedules, the Zoom settled on tomorrow at 10 AM - nothing left to arrange.

resolved.title: Brunswick intro set with Lauren Nadig
resolved.detail: You confirmed and the Teams call went onto today's calendar.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: Autumn calls for something with more heft on the plate as the evenings draw in.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: Open all morning - the kind of stretch that quietly swallows the Croatia to-do list if you let it.
A single call breaks the afternoon; on either side, the time is yours.
Moving houses to the St Pete ranch tonight - settle in and cook something from scratch.
